Remark
[Basic properties of weak convergence] ↗ def:weak-convergence ↗ def:convergence-normed-space 1. appD:D.4-rem-1\group Functional Analysis

Strong convergence implies weak convergence. Every weakly convergent sequence is bounded, and \[ u_k\rightharpoonup u \quad \Longrightarrow \quad \| u\| \leq \liminf _{k\to \infty }\| u_k\| . \]
